description: Defines a custom exception class SerializationConstructorNotFoundException used within the Orleans.Serialization namespace to indicate missing serialization constructors.

classes.name: SerializationConstructorNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a type lacks a suitable serialization constructor.

methods.name: SerializationConstructorNotFoundException(Type type)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating the missing serialization constructor for the given type.
